text:
maria: Morning check-in — quick status + blockers pls. Post what you did yesterday / blockers / plan today. TL;DR appreciated :coffee:

alex: Yesterday: merged batching perf patch, verified 95th p50 latency on small repro. Blocker: failing e2e in Dedicated staging (OOM on 8k seq). Today: root cause triage with eng-runtime, will try quantization profile tweak. @kevin can you drop the staging logs? :pray:

kevin: Dropped logs to s3://redwood-staging/logs/oom/1768.tar.gz — includes heap, dmesg, and container traces. Lmk if you need a filtered subset.

alex: thanks — pulling now.

sara: Yesterday: landed docs for model pinning + rollout UI. No blockers. Today: polish tutorial and sync w/ Product on wording. Ping @maria for release notes blurb.

maria: noted, will add a short summary to the release notes section.

tj: Yesterday: code review for routing policy PR #2143 (left comments). Blocker: need decision on default fallback order (cost-first vs latency-first). Suggest latency-first for now (preserves UX). Anyone object?

kevin: latency-first seems right for PLG but make it configurable per-route. No infra objections.

alex: agree, latency-first default. Document the override.

tj: cool, I'll update the PR and add a config sample:

```
fallback_policy:
  default: latency_first
  overrides:
    - route: /embeddings
      policy: cost_first
```

ops-bot: deploy started: dedicated-staging/2026-03-18T08:05Z by @ci-bot

ci-bot: build passed on routing-policy branch, running integration tests.

alex: Quick note — if anyone hears from customers about higher failure rate on embeddings, that was from yesterday's batch purge job (fixed). Recommend adding short retry for 409s in SDK.

sara: good call, opened issue #386 (sdk-retries) and linked the purge postmortem.

maria: blockers summary: alex working on OOM, tj will update PR, sara docs + release notes. kevin monitoring staging. Anything else?

kevin: no further blockers, I'll watch for flakiness on the batch job after alex's change.

maria: thanks team — updates collected. I'll assemble the all-hands highlights and send a follow-up if any action items need owners. :white_check_mark:
